host_physical_partition.interpretation: Disjoint measured host categories with proportional PSS attribution inside anonymous/shmem/file-cache categories. PSS assigns shared-page fractions, not ownership. CUDA API pin bytes are overlapping evidence and are NOT added. Free is the observed physical safety floor; MemAvailable is separate reclaim-aware headroom. Observed file cache is not proof of the minimum required working set.

host_pinned_backing.method: Union by shared mapping (device,inode,file offset), excluding device-pointer aliases. Not PFN/pagemap measurement. Unresolved private/anonymous mappings are separate.

device_nvml.process_attribution: PID match only. NVIDIA may report host PIDs while /proc uses container PIDs; do not substitute a sole process without a verified namespace mapping.

device_capacity_partition.interpretation: Application requested bytes are inside NVML used. The remaining used bytes include context/modules/vendor pools/other clients/alignment; they are not split by guesswork. Reserved and free are separate. Signed rounding reflects MiB-granularity NVML reporting.
